name: Rain NO wide window
description: rain-no's rule on the earlier part of the market's life: 6-30 h before the close (the evening before to midday), buy NO at the YES bid when a taker hits it and the bid is 10-75c, one entry per city-day. rain-no itself only trades the last 6 h.
hypothesis: Same mechanism as rain-no (retail pays for forecast chance of rain; the market resolves on >0.00 in at the station). Dev screen (first trade after h<=18/30, day-clustered): YES overpriced by 7-21c in the 10-75c buckets (n 100-135 per bucket, se 3-6c), same sign at every horizon. Wrong if the walk-forward CI (net of fees) is <=0: earlier quotes are wider and less informed, so the spread may eat it, and the effect could be mostly the late-window information in rain-no. Adds ~2x markets to rain-no's 163 dev entries.
